body: The warm light, though faint, seems to envelop me like a comforting blanket, reminding me of the countless nights I've stood by my friends, listening to their melodies and sharing in their moments of triumph. Next, I stay beside them and keep them steady, letting the gentle glow of the loft light seep into my soul, illuminating the path ahead.
